record.outcome: The three Batch E deliverables are in place. Every record dated on or after 2026-09-12 opens only with the planner's plan.md beside its report and closes only when every phase is done or dropped with a reason; apply, checkpoint, close, start-batch, check-batch, finish-batch and the runner closeout all run the same gate from scripts/workflow/batch-files.js. A Figma batch saves its first read-only walk as inventory.json, chooses later reads from it, and re-verifies the nodes it will mutate in Figma before the first write: the composed script fails on drift before its body runs, the helpers' creators refuse to write until the check passed, check-batch refuses a mutation until the latest recorded reverification is clean, and close and finish require it once mutations are listed. A repository batch with an inventory is refused. The scaffold writes plan.md, declares batchKind, plan and inventory, and writes the walk script for a Figma batch. This record was scaffolded, opened and closed through that tooling; its first apply was refused by its own gate because the template sentence named the placeholder marker, fixed before the record opened.
